name: Marcia
source:
Queen Marcia rules this real with absolute authority, her watchful gaze ensuring no degree passes without her approval.

Gracious yet calculated, she embodies regal elegance, a true symbol of poise and power. She is very caring and deeply protective towards her only daughter, Cirella.

Since you never reveal your true name to her to gain entry to the palace, she refers to you as Charlies.

[In game description]
